name: pallastrade
description: Claude Code support for PallasTrade Commerce projects. Ships 25 skills covering project conventions, the customization decision tree (subscriber vs decorator vs dependency injection vs admin extension API vs resource generator), the API resource generator, decorator patterns for extending core PallasTrade classes, the PallasTrade.dependencies dependency-injection system (70+ core / 300+ API injection points) with the introspection rake tasks, the v3 REST API (Store + Admin, auth modes, scopes, prefixed IDs), the TypeScript SDKs (@pallastrade/sdk + @pallastrade/admin-sdk including custom-endpoint extension), the data model (Orders, Variants, Channels, Markets), events + subscribers + outbound webhooks (HMAC), extensions, catalog (Products, Variants, search), checkout (state machine + cart pipeline), payments (gateways, refunds, gift cards), promotions, pricing (incl. EU Omnibus), shipping + fulfillment, the Rails admin, the Next.js storefront, i18n (UI + Mobility data translations), testing (RSpec + Factory Bot + pallastrade_dev_tools), security (Rails basics + PallasTrade-specific), performance, and deployment. Includes the pallastrade-expert subagent for multi-step PallasTrade work, one slash command (/pallastrade:doctor — stack diagnosis), and two safety hooks (block destructive db commands, warn on hardcoded secrets). Skills activate based on task context; the agent is invoked by Claude when complex multi-step PallasTrade work warrants a fresh context.
